title: General
text: The purpose of this procedure is to request a particular UE to provide specific identification parameters, e.g. the SUCI, the IMEI, the IMEISV, the EUI-64 or the MAC address. The SUCI is a privacy preserving identifier containing the concealed SUPI and the IMEI, the IMEISV, the EUI-64 and the MAC address are formats of PEI
